decisions.reason: Removing Heyzine platform branding does not change the PDF deliverable or its two-page-spread display behavior.
The white-label request does not change the established launch deadline or required live-launch state.

The source message separately changes article whitespace handling, but that impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY and failure Events; the hosting-branding change adds nothing further.
Heyzine's platform branding is distinct from the magazine layout's WBEdition visual style and color rules.
The platform white-label request does not alter the requirement to enhance publication image quality.
Removing hosting-platform branding does not change advertisement rendering quality.
The white-label hosting decision has no effect on author names, photographs, sizing, shape, coverage, or source.
Platform branding does not alter the selected article body typeface or weight treatment.
The white-label hosting request does not change table-of-contents completion or page-number accuracy requirements.
